newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna extends suspension of Verbund.
newsitem.headline: Vienna extends suspension of Verbund.

text.p: The Vienna stock exchange said on Monday it was extending the suspension of trading in the shares and options of national utility Verbund to 0915 GMT on Wednesday morning from the initial 0815 GMT.

Oesterreichische Elektrizitaetswirtschafts-AG (Verbund) asked the stock exchange to suspend its shares until 0915 GMT on Wednesday ahead of the release of its first-half earnings, the bourse said. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 258
